description: This file defines a PHP class TimeConfigPeriodAPI within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for managing timesheet period configurations via REST API endpoints. It includes methods for retrieving and updating the timesheet period, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPI
classes.description: Handles API requests related to configuring and retrieving timesheet period settings in the HRM system.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of TimesheetPeriodService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current timesheet period configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint (excludes 'id' parameter).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the timesheet period start day and enables related menu items.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating the timesheet period, including ensuring it is not already defined.
